claims.claim_text: The TruFor image-level manipulation score is 0.999.
claims.brief_justification: A reported numeric score; not checkable from the images.

claims.claim_text: This indicates a high likelihood of authenticity.
claims.brief_justification: The surfboard nose in the annotated area differs between IMAGE A (black speckled deck with yellow rail) and IMAGE B (pale cream deck with a coloured logo decal), so altered content is present.

claims.claim_text: There is a localized region in the center-left.
claims.brief_justification: IMAGE C's single white wedge sits ~96% inside the center-left cell; IMAGE D outlines the board nose there.

claims.claim_text: That region has a high mean and max probability.
claims.brief_justification: Reported score values, not visually checkable.

claims.claim_text: This suggests the presence of a specific feature or object in that region.
claims.brief_justification: The annotated center-left region does contain a distinct object: the exposed nose of the surfboard.
IMAGE A clearly shows a man in a black wetsuit crouched on a surfboard in breaking whitewater.

notes: Location, the presence of an object in the annotated region, and the surfer description are all corroborated. The authenticity conclusion is contradicted by the A-versus-B difference in the board nose inside that very region, and reading a 0.999 manipulation score as evidence of authenticity is internally inconsistent.
